verdict.rationale: The op CLI integrates with the local desktop app and can be scripted to list and read vault items (e.g. `op item list --vault Private`), so an agent can query it without screen-scraping. Connect Servers add a private REST API over vaults, and the SDKs and service accounts allow programmatic secret access. The Environments MCP server, however, deliberately does not return secrets to the agent. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of fetching one-time codes programmatically, a documented local agent-facing endpoint (as opposed to a CLI or a self-hosted Connect deployment), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents querying the vault.
